title: Implement a Todo List Component
description: You are given a basic HTML structure for a todo list application. Your task is to implement the missing JavaScript functionality to make it work. The application should allow users to add, remove, and toggle completion status of todo items.

features.name: Add Todo Item
features.description: Implement functionality to add new todo items to the list when the user clicks the 'Add' button or presses Enter.
testCases: Should add a new todo item when Add button is clicked
Should add a new todo item when Enter key is pressed
Should clear the input field after adding
Should not add empty todo items

features.name: Toggle Todo Completion
features.description: Implement functionality to toggle the completion status of a todo item when clicked.
testCases: Should toggle completion status when todo item is clicked
Should update visual appearance when toggled

features.name: Remove Todo Item
features.description: Implement functionality to remove a todo item when the delete button is clicked.
testCases: Should remove todo item when delete button is clicked
Should update the list after removal
